specs.name: 프리즘 코어
specs.direction: Design direction A — PRISM CORE. Bold, angular bespoke serif capitals with chisel-cut terminals and broad stable silver faces. Work tiny violet cut-glass facets into the INNER COUNTERS of the two As and one small diamond at the low centre. Below the letters a short architectural silver rail tapers into sharp triangular tips, directly echoing the approved HUD gauges. Precisely joined metal and crystal, fairly compact and symmetrical. No clock, circular dial, swirls or filigree; this direction is crystalline geometry and substantial lettering. The letters should feel engraved from one silver slab with individual bevel faces. The small purple features are accents, not glowing gaps replacing strokes.
specs.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE original fantasy RPG title wordmark, with a genuine transparent alpha background, for ASTELLA. EXACT text is ASTELLA, seven capital letters A S T E L L A in one horizontal line, perfectly readable. No other words, letters, numbers, slogans or labels.
Image 1 is a QUALITY AND MATERIAL reference, the first detailed silver/amethyst ASTELLA logo: sculpted but readable fantasy serif lettering, broad pearly silver faces, narrow lavender metal bevels and precise faceted violet crystal. Image 2 is the approved game HUD material reference. Make a NEW composition at the same illustrated art quality, NOT a normal-font mockup. Preserve silver, cool ivory and amethyst identity and clear silhouettes at 600px displayed width. The title must be the main subject; ornament supports it. Premium painted fantasy title art, intentional engraved details and depth, restrained highlights and fine dark-indigo edge definition. Transparent compact wide layout about 3:1 to 3.5:1, generous enough safety margins to keep both As and every flourish intact.

specs.name: 멈춘 시계
specs.direction: Design direction B — STILL TIME. Elegant elongated fantasy serif capitals, refined sharp serifs, original letter shapes. Behind the centre of the word is a thin INCOMPLETE engraved clock dial in pale silver, approximately half the word height above its top edge, with deliberate fine tick marks and two slender stopped hands. Most of the dial is occluded by the readable letters and two segments are missing. The dial is secondary; no roman numerals or numbers. A small suspended amethyst lozenge at the lower central baseline balances the clock. Asymmetrical, graceful and mysterious, with a fine silver arc fragment toward one side. No big watch case, no massive medallion, no square border.

specs.name: 성소 각인
specs.direction: Design direction C — SANCTUARY ENGRAVING. Tall, slender, ceremonial silver serif lettering, the strokes tapering like carefully engraved metal. Flank the lower word with two short chamfered silver brackets and small violet inlays, as if the title was lifted from an ancient silver sanctuary tablet. Use a precise open geometric UNDERLINE with shallow angular steps, rather than a full box around the word. One delicate low central V-like cut supports a tiny deep-violet prism, without the literal letter V. Small chisel lines and slight aged-metal shadow give craft. Frontal, calm symmetry, architectural elegance. NO arches, church towers, windows, crowns, wings or clock.

specs.name: 깨진 봉인
specs.direction: Design direction D — BROKEN SEAL. Confident broad fantasy serif ASTELLA with slightly darker brushed silver faces, bright narrow bevels and amethyst recessed edges. Three thin DIAGONAL FRACTURE lines cross only tiny portions of the metal, never separating or obscuring a letter. Three small faceted violet fragments sit below and slightly to the right of the central word, joined by a broken silver engraving rail. The word stays intact and easy to read. An angular, off-balance outline, purposeful asymmetry and a sense of a seal recently loosened. No circular clock, decorative stars, huge floating shards, fire, dark smoke, gold or aggressive neon.

specs.name: 은빛 서약
specs.direction: Design direction E — SILVER COVENANT. Graceful, high-contrast fantasy serif lettering with a few controlled calligraphic silver extensions, like a hand-crafted expedition chronicle title made in metal. The A and final A have slightly long tapered outer feet; a fine silver calligraphic underline connects into a SMALL four-strand engraved knot at the lower centre with a single amethyst cut-stone inlay. Allow ONE flowing silver curve behind the word, not an orbit or halo. Pearl-silver large letter faces, lavender bevel shadows and restrained intricate engraving on the underline. Airy and literary, a refined silhouette distinct from the angular prism, clock and tablet variants. No clock, enclosing rectangle, foliage wreath, wing, crown, star particles or large jewel.
